description: Adversarial certificate and CRL fixtures (H4, part that cannot come from the Alloy model). Each case names a construction that packages/core/src/adversarial-certificate.test.ts performs with a test PKI generated at run time (RSA 2048, SHA-256), and the answer the library must give: for kind=crl, checkRevocation(crl, serial, issuer AC certificate, pastNextUpdate=refuse) at 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z; for kind=cms, verifyIcpSignature(CMS over the challenge, expectedCnpj, anchors) at the same instant. `expect` is either {"revoked": bool} or {"error": KyaError code, "message": regular expression}.
